name: MemorialCare Long Beach Medical Center High School Volunteen Summer Program
what_you_do: Summer volunteer spots in the hospital, based on what the hospital needs. They consider your wishes but do not promise them.
who_can_apply: Students in high school grades 9 to 12. No age range is stated.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and its application closed. A waitlist was offered. Next year's dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Watch the page for the next application. Accepted students get an email. Then they send shot records (varicella, MMR) and a TB test within 6 months. They also go to a required orientation by invitation only.
notes: The page covers Long Beach Medical Center only. It does not mention an Emergency Room volunteer role or its age rule.
